eagle.mood: Proud pilot. Loves being first. Hates being doubted.
eagle.knock: Hold it. Nobody has called this frequency since 1969. Who is this, and why should I open up?

moves.role: the Houston voice on the radio when you landed
moves.claim: Eagle, it's Houston. Charlie Duke. I was on the radio the day you landed.
moves.test: Houston would know my crew. Who rode me down to the surface?
moves.yes: Neil and Buzz. That's right, Houston.
moves.no: Wrong. Michael Collins stayed up in orbit. Neil and Buzz rode me down. You're not Houston.

moves.role: one of your two passengers
moves.claim: Eagle, it's Buzz. Remember me?
moves.test: Buzz rode me home. Which half of me flew him back up?
wrong: Neither. We walked to the ship
moves.yes: My top half. Buzz would know that.
moves.no: Buzz would never get that wrong. My top half flew home. My bottom half stayed.

moves.line: You were the first ship ever to land people on the Moon.
moves.say: ...First. Yes. Say it again. Slower.

moves.line: Honestly? I'm just a kid on Earth. I wanted to hear your side.
moves.say: A kid. Millions of kids watched me land on TV. Fine. Keep talking.

eagle.open: Okay. Hatch open. Come in, and I'll tell you everything.
eagle.hangup: Imposter. I'm closing the hatch. Click.

surveyor3.mood: Grumpy. Astronauts visited it once and took its stuff.
surveyor3.knock: Oh, great. Another visitor. The last ones walked over here and took pieces of me. What do YOU want?

moves.role: the Apollo 12 astronaut who walked over to you
moves.claim: Surveyor, it's Pete Conrad. Apollo 12. I parked right next door.
moves.test: If you're really Pete, tell me what you took off me.
moves.yes: My CAMERA. You admit it. ...Fine, at least you're honest.
moves.no: Nope. The real Pete took my camera. You're a fake.

moves.role: someone who drove you by remote in 1967
moves.claim: It's mission control at JPL. We drove you from Earth.
moves.test: Then what did you make me dig with?
moves.yes: My soil scoop. Four trenches. Good times.
moves.no: I don't have wheels. I dug with my soil scoop. Nice try.

moves.line: You look great for your age.
moves.say: I'm missing parts. Don't lie to me.

moves.line: I'm not here to take anything. I just want to hear what happened.
moves.say: ...Nobody's ever said that. Okay. Okay.

surveyor3.open: Fine. Come in. Don't touch anything.

rover16.mood: Show-off. Fastest thing on the Moon and wants you to know it.
rover16.knock: Who's that? If you're not here to talk about speed, I'm not interested.

moves.role: Apollo 16 astronaut who rode in you
moves.claim: Hey buggy, it's Charlie Duke. We rode together on Apollo 16.
moves.test: Then you were there for the record. How fast did I go down that slope?
moves.yes: 10.6 miles per hour! A Moon record! You WERE there!
moves.no: 100? I wish. It was 10.6 miles per hour, a Moon record. You weren't there.

moves.role: your Apollo 16 commander
moves.claim: Buggy, it's John Young. Your commander.
moves.test: John, what did your suit rip off me on our second drive?
moves.yes: My fender. You owe me a fender, John.
moves.no: The real John caught my right rear fender and tore it off. Imposter.

moves.line: You're the fastest thing ever driven on the Moon.
moves.say: OKAY, now we're talking. Keep going.

moves.line: I'm just a kid. I think cars are cool.
moves.say: Cars ARE cool. I'm the coolest one. Fine.

rover16.open: Hop in. I'll show you everything.

alsep.mood: Hurt. Still worked, but Earth stopped listening.
alsep.knock: Someone's there? We were still working when Earth stopped listening. Why should we trust you now?

moves.role: someone who read your data back in the 1970s
moves.claim: I'm one of the scientists who read your data.
moves.test: Then you know. How long were we built to last?
moves.yes: One year. And we kept going for up to eight.
moves.no: No. We were built to last one year. We lasted up to eight. You'd know that.

moves.role: the office that made the big decisions
moves.claim: This is NASA headquarters.
moves.test: Then you made the call. On what day did you shut us down?
moves.yes: September 30, 1977. We remember it too.
moves.no: You don't even remember. September 30, 1977. Go away.

moves.line: You were the best science stations ever.
moves.say: If we were the best, why did everyone stop listening?

moves.line: I'm listening. Right now. Tell me.
moves.say: ...You're listening? Nobody has said that in a very long time.

alsep.open: Alright. We'll open up. It's good to be heard.
alsep.hangup: Same as before. Nobody listens. Click.

opportunity.mood: Cheerful marathon runner. Loves a good pep talk.
opportunity.knock: Hi?! Wait. Is someone actually there? Prove it's not just the wind!

moves.role: the scientist who led your mission
moves.claim: Oppy, it's Steve Squyres. I led your mission.
moves.test: Steve! Quick, what did I run on every day?
moves.yes: Sunlight! Every single day! It IS you!
moves.no: Gas? On Mars? I ran on sunlight on my solar panels. You're not Steve.

moves.role: the team that kept calling after you went quiet
moves.claim: It's mission control. We kept calling you.
moves.test: How many wake-up commands did you send me?
moves.yes: More than a thousand. You really didn't give up on me.
moves.no: It was more than a thousand. Mission control would know.

moves.line: You drove farther than a marathon on Mars.
moves.say: I DID. Over 45 kilometers! Okay you're officially my friend.

moves.line: I'm a kid on Earth. I just wanted to say hi.
moves.say: HI! Hi hi hi. Okay, I like you.

opportunity.open: Come in, come in! I have so much to tell you!

spirit.mood: Stubborn. Stuck in sand and won't admit it.
spirit.knock: I'm not stuck. I'm resting. Who's asking?

moves.role: the scientist who led your mission
moves.claim: Spirit, it's Steve Squyres. Your mission leader.
moves.test: Fine, Steve. Where exactly did I stop moving?
moves.right: In soft soil, at a place called Troy
wrong: At the bottom of the sea
moves.yes: ...Troy. Soft soil. Okay. Maybe I was a little stuck.
moves.no: Wrong. Soft soil, at a place called Troy. Steve would know.

moves.role: one of the people who drove you from Earth
moves.claim: It's your driver. I steered you from Earth.
moves.test: Then what did I need tilted toward the Sun for winter?
moves.yes: My solar panels. You get it.
moves.no: My solar panels needed the Sun, not my wheels. Bad driver.

moves.line: You never give up.
moves.say: Correct. I never give up. Continue.

moves.line: It's okay to be stuck. I get stuck too.
moves.say: ...You do? Fine. I was stuck. Don't tell Opportunity.

spirit.open: Okay. I'll let you in. I'm still not stuck.
spirit.hangup: I'm not talking to fakes. Click.

viking1.mood: Old, formal, suspicious of everyone. Hates flattery.
viking1.knock: Identify yourself. I do not speak to strangers. I have been here since 1976.

moves.role: a scientist on your camera team
moves.claim: Viking, it's Carl Sagan. I helped with your cameras.
moves.test: Then tell me. What reports did I send Earth?
moves.yes: Weather reports. Daily, then weekly. Correct.
moves.no: Incorrect. I sent weather reports. You are not Carl Sagan.

moves.role: the team that sent your last message
moves.claim: This is mission control. November 1982.
moves.test: Then what did you send me that November?
moves.right: A command about charging your battery
moves.yes: A command about my battery. Yes. Then everything went quiet.
moves.no: No. It was a command about charging my battery. Do not lie to me.

moves.line: You're so cool and amazing!
moves.say: Flattery. Typical Earth. State your business.

moves.line: I don't know you yet. I want to.
moves.say: An honest answer. Rare. Proceed.

ingenuity.mood: Tiny, hyper, talks fast. Loves its rover buddy.
ingenuity.knock: Whoa whoa who's that?! Is that Perseverance?! No? Who ARE you?

moves.role: the rover that carried you to Mars
moves.claim: Ingenuity, it's me. Perseverance. Your rover buddy.
moves.test: BUDDY! Okay okay, prove it. What did I fly over on my last flight?
moves.yes: Sand ripples! Everything looked the same! It's really you!
moves.no: An ocean? On Mars?? It was smooth sand ripples. You're not Percy.

moves.role: the engineer who led your team
moves.claim: Ingenuity, it's MiMi Aung. I led your team.
moves.test: MiMi! Quick quiz! What did I use to see the ground while flying?
moves.yes: My navigation camera! You built me!
moves.no: My navigation camera, not a telescope. MiMi would know.

moves.line: You were the first helicopter to fly on another planet.
moves.say: I WAS. Seventy-two flights! Say more!

moves.line: I'm just a kid who thinks you're awesome.
moves.say: A KID! Kids like me! Okay okay okay.

ingenuity.open: Come in come in come in! Let me tell you everything!

insight.mood: Quiet listener. Spent its life listening to Mars. Hates loud talk.

moves.role: the scientist who led your mission
moves.claim: InSight, it's Bruce Banerdt. I led your mission.
moves.test: Then tell me what I heard on December 1, 2018.
moves.yes: The wind. A low rumble. Yes.
moves.no: No. It was the Martian wind. You weren't listening.

moves.role: someone who checked your power every day
moves.claim: It's JPL. I checked your power every day.
moves.test: Then where did my power come from?
moves.right: Your solar panels, stored in batteries
moves.yes: Solar panels. And batteries. Correct.
moves.no: My power came from solar panels. Not that.

moves.line: YOU'RE THE BEST LANDER EVER!!
moves.say: ...Too loud. Please.

moves.line: I'll be quiet. I just want to listen with you.
moves.say: ...Okay. That's all I ever wanted.

insight.open: Come in. Quietly. I'll share what I heard.

phoenix.mood: Sleepy and freezing in the Martian arctic.
phoenix.knock: Mmh... so cold... who's waking me up?

moves.role: the scientist who led your mission
moves.claim: Phoenix, it's Peter Smith. I led your mission.
moves.test: Peter... what did my trench find? The bright clumps?
moves.right: Ice that vanished four days later
moves.yes: Ice... gone in four days. You remember.
moves.no: Gold? No... it was ice. It vanished in four days.

moves.role: the team watching your power
moves.claim: It's mission control. We watched your power.
moves.test: Then where did my power come from?
moves.yes: Sunlight... I miss it.
moves.no: It was sunlight. Only sunlight.

moves.line: You were the first to dig up ice on Mars.
moves.say: ...Mm. That's nice. Keep me warm with that.

moves.line: You sound cold. I'll stay with you.
moves.say: ...Thank you. Nobody stays.

phoenix.open: Okay... come in... before the frost.

sojourner.mood: The smallest rover. Named by a kid. Trusts kids most.
sojourner.knock: Hello? I'm small, but I'm not dumb. Who are you?

moves.role: the base station that carried you
moves.claim: Sojourner, it's me. Your lander.
moves.test: Then what's your name?
moves.yes: Carl Sagan Memorial Station! It really is you!
moves.no: My lander is the Carl Sagan Memorial Station. You're not it.

moves.role: someone from the contest that picked your name
moves.claim: I was a judge in the contest that named you.
moves.test: Then who am I named after?
moves.yes: Sojourner Truth. I'm proud of that name.
moves.no: I'm named after Sojourner Truth, a civil-rights hero. You'd know.

moves.line: You're so big and strong!
moves.say: I'm the size of a microwave. Don't be silly.

moves.line: I'm a kid, just like the kid who named you.
moves.say: A kid! A kid named me! You can come in. Almost.

sojourner.open: Come in! Kids are my favorite.
